details.label: Summary
details.text: A few damaging gusts may accompany the stronger storms over the next few hours. A brief tornado cannot be ruled out

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Multicells, transient supercells, and short line segments have become established along/ahead of a surface trough. These storms are overspreading a boundary layer characterized by 80s/70s F surface temperatures/dewpoints, where 1000-1500 J/kg MLCAPE is in place, along with 30-40 kts of effective bulk shear. The current thinking is that these storms will maintain their intensity and continue to pose a risk for a few damaging gusts. A brief tornado also cannot be ruled out, especially for any storms that anchor on the baroclinic boundary, roughly established along the OH/PA/NY border area
